learner_use.first_use: Only verified net-new/update/conflict content enters bounded learner work.
learner_use.unchanged_content: PRESERVE content keeps the accepted Current learning path and does not become new debt.
learner_use.verification: Use changed-context or delayed evidence when the delta changes a score-relevant capability; same-item correction is insufficient.

fallback.late: Continue with accepted Current M1-M10 baseline and preserve explicit 27-delta uncertainty.
fallback.partial: Bind only verified received parts; missing parts remain UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
fallback.second_version: Treat v2 as semantic revision; run transitive invalidation before new Current authorization.
fallback.never_arrives: Use accepted Current baseline; preserve missing-current-year uncertainty and stop waiting after the last useful assimilation window.
fallback.low_value: Do not admit merely because it exists; compare net-new score/capability value against overlap, latency and remaining capacity.

forecast_contract.before_arrival: No invented 27-cycle minutes or point-risk number. Keep the delta blocked/unpriced.
forecast_contract.after_arrival: Forecast consumes only verified net-new/replacement-adjusted learner workload.
forecast_contract.authority: Forecast does not decide whether the source is admitted and does not choose the next System.
